expected-value.def: The mean, or expected value, of a discrete random variable X is $\mu_X = E(X) = \sum x_i p_i$: each value times its probability, added up. It is the average value of X over very many repetitions of the chance process.

rv-sd.def: The standard deviation of a discrete random variable X is $\sigma_X = \sqrt{\sum (x_i - \mu_X)^2 p_i}$. It measures how far the values of X typically are from the mean, in the units of X. Its square, before the square root, is the variance.
